text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the herbal tea present~, 
Sky-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's Chinese herbal medicine... with 
cinnamon, right? The kind that replenishes 
the body's yang energy and warms you up 
from the inside.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, as expected, you're quite 
knowledgeable. Yes, exactly. I hope you 
can enjoy a nice, relaxing, cozy time for 
your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe as your roommate, I might even 
get a share of the treat too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's your scheme♪ However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that part of you, Sky-chan, is 
something I really love.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ? What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A little while back, when it was a bit 
chilly, you gave me some hot ginger tea, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You said back then that you just wanted a 
drink yourself, but... it really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
These "glass legs" of mine— if they get 
cold, it becomes hard for me to run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right? Sky-chan is always cooking up such 
wonderful 'schemes' for us.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, that's just a coincidence. Both 
last time and this time, all I wanted was 
to enjoy some nice, cozy sunshine time~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah, you're right. Then let's warm 
up together with some herbal tea. For old 
roommate's sake♪
